text:
Ethan Park: Hi team  first day! I was expecting my monitor delivery this morning but the courier status shows 'attempted delivery'. Desk A1-09. Also my company webcam (in the packing list) is missing from the box. Anyone know who to ping for re-delivery or to check ops inventory?

Olivia Hart: Welcome Ethan! Sorry about that. Could you confirm the tracking number from the packing slip? Ops will check with the courier. Also we keep a small stock of webcams if the courier lost it.

Ethan Park: Packing slip tracking: RW-998233. I checked the box twice  monitor stand and cables are there but no webcam kit.

Noah Singh: @Ethan Park thanks for flagging. I'll create a ticket and ask ops to confirm courier attempt and pull a spare webcam. Are you at Building A, 1st floor? I'll aim for a same-day drop if someone is nearby.

it-bot: New ticket created: IT-5077  "Monitor delivery attempted; webcam missing from shipment". Assigned to Olivia Hart. ETA: ops check in 2 hours.

Olivia Hart: Checked with courier  they had trouble with the loading bay and left a notice. They can attempt re-delivery tomorrow morning. I pulled one spare Logitech C920 from ops (asset CAM-1015). I can hand-deliver it at 4pm today if that helps.

Ethan Park: 4pm delivery would be perfect, thanks! And re-delivery for the monitor tomorrow morning is fine.

Noah Singh: Noted. Ethan, when you get the spare cam try plugging it in to your laptop USB and testing with QuickTime (Video > New Movie Recording) on macOS or Camera app on Windows. If the cam isn't recognized, ping me and I'll bring a USB-C adapter.

Olivia Hart: Dropped off CAM-1015 at 4:05pm and left a sticky note with asset tag. Confirmed monitor re-delivery scheduled with courier for tomorrow 09:00-11:00.

Ethan Park: Received the webcam  camera works in QuickTime instantly. Monitor re-delivery arrived at 09:20 next day and setup is complete. Everything looks good. Thanks everyone!

Noah Singh: Great to hear. Closing IT-5077: webcam supplied (CAM-1015) and monitor re-delivered. If anything else on onboarding needs help DM me. :white_check_mark:

it-bot: Ticket IT-5077 status changed to RESOLVED by Noah Singh on 1772501250.
